name: ACB

amountMinVnd.note: Not stated on the product page.

amountMaxVnd.note: Page does not state the limit. A 2012 VnExpress article says salary-account overdraft up to 100 triệu, but it is 14 years old and not used.

termMaxMonths.note: Page: 'Thời hạn vay lên đến 12 tháng'.

minPercent.note: Page: 'Lãi suất chỉ từ 0.06%/ngày theo số ngày thực tế sử dụng'. 'Chỉ từ' = starting rate, not the rate a borrower gets. Stored as quoted (per day); a simple x365 is about 21.9%/year but the page does not give a yearly figure and does not say how interest compounds.

basis.note: Page says interest is charged on actual days used but does not say flat or reducing.

rates.segment: Lãi suất cho vay bình quân toàn ACB kỳ tháng 09/2026 (không phải lãi suất của sản phẩm này)

minPercent.note: Page: 'lãi suất bình quân của các khoản vay mới giải ngân trong kỳ tháng 09/2026'; ACB says it is 'không phải là lãi suất áp dụng đối với từng khoản vay cụ thể'. Mostly secured and business loans; do not use as a consumer rate.

amortization.note: Overdraft limit with interest paid on the 15th of each month; principal due within the term. Schedule not detailed.

fixedVnd.note: Page: 'Không phí quản lý thấu chi'. Other fees (e.g. early repayment, account) not published on this page, absence is not proof of zero.

maxAge.note: Page: 'tuổi tối đa bao gồm thời hạn cho vay'.

documents.note: Not stated; registration is done in the ACB ONE app.

existingCustomerRequired.note: Page requires an ACB ONE account (so an ACB customer). Salary through ACB is not stated.

value: Có tài khoản đăng nhập ACB ONE
Đáp ứng điều kiện tín dụng của ACB từng thời kỳ

eligibility.notes: Interest-free (100%) if the limit is used and repaid the same day before 17:00 Mon-Fri (12:00 Saturday). Interest paid on the 15th monthly. Tab content read via text fetch only.

textVi.note: Not stated on the page; no published consumer fee schedule located.

products.excludeReason: ACB chỉ công bố mức 'từ 0,06%/ngày' (lãi suất khởi điểm), không có khoảng lãi suất thực tế, không rõ cách tính, hạn mức và phí khác, nên chưa so sánh được.
products.notes: Only a starting daily rate is published. Not rankable.

researchNotes: 1) Licence: 'acb' is on data/licensed-institutions.json (bank, GP 91/GP-NHNN). 2) Official consumer loan list (https://acb.com.vn/vay-von, read 2026-11-02) shows only ONE unsecured product: Thấu chi tiêu dùng Online. Others are secured (thế chấp, cầm cố, mua nhà, xây sửa nhà) and out of scope. No official salary-based/tín chấp cash loan page found: guessed URLs return 'Không tìm thấy trang'; /vay-von has no such product. Third-party sites (cellphones, topi, muaban) quote 10-23%/năm for ACB tín chấp (flat vs reducing figures that differ across sites); these are secondary, undated, not recorded. A 2012 VnExpress article describes an old fixed-on-original-balance tín chấp plan up to 500 triệu/60 months: obsolete, not used. 3) Rate: only 'từ 0,06%/ngày' (floor, daily) for overdraft; the 9,53%/năm figure at /lai-suat-cho-vay is a bank-wide average for new loans in 09/2026, stored as benchmark. 4) Gaps: no personal loan biểu phí found (only credit card/debit card/business PDFs); early repayment fee, late-penalty, insurance, overdraft limit, income and documents unknown. Business fee page lists overdraft limit management fee 0.2%/month, which is business only. 5) Credit cards: ACB publishes card fee/rate PDFs (https://acb.com.vn/acbwebsite/files/Bieu_phi_the_tin_dung.pdf, effective 1/1/2026, adjustment notice 16/7/2026) but the PDF text could not be extracted in this run, so no card product recorded; cards are out of MVP ranking anyway. 6) 'Giảm lãi vay tự động' (https://acb.com.vn/vay-von/giam-lai-vay-tu-dong) is a rate-reduction program for existing borrowers with CASA >= 10 triệu; no percentages published. 7) Surprising: ACB's main page for salaried workers does not list a tín chấp loan at all; www.acb.com.vn legacy portal URL returned 503.
